subject: Mental Models
title: Black Swan Events
description: A micro-lesson that makes Black Swan Events usable.

hook.text: Before 1697, every European believed all swans were white. Then explorers found black swans in Australia.

buildup.text: Nassim Taleb coined Black Swan for rare.

discovery.text: Black Swans have three traits: they are rare, they carry extreme impact.

twist.text: Our models assume normal distributions. But history is driven by extreme outliers that no bell curve predicts.

punchline.text: You cannot predict extremes. Build to survive them.

quiz.question: What are the three traits of a Black Swan event according to Taleb?
